title: Blessed Be the Name
style: Early 90s EBM, 124 BPM, pulsing sequenced bass, hard machine drums, noisy synth stabs, numbers-station radio, growled processed male vocal, industrial church bells, dark sacred undertone, distant choir stab
negativeTags: pop, country, acoustic, happy, ballad, chiptune, synthwave
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Numbers-station voice, distorted) Request to the throne... permission granted... the hedge is down

[Verse 1]
(Growled)
I said strip him to the bone and he'll curse You to Your face
Sabeans took the oxen, fire fell and burned the place
Chaldeans took the camels, then I sent the desert wind
And the house came down on the feast where his children had been

[Pre-Chorus]
I took it all
I waited for the fall

[Chorus]
(Chant, gang vocals)
Blessed be the Name
I took it all, he stayed the same
The Lord gave, the Lord took away
Blessed be the Name, and I'm put to shame

[Verse 2]
(Growled)
I covered him in boils from his head down to his feet
He sat down in the ashes, scraping with a shard in the heat
His wife said curse your God and die, his friends said you're to blame
But he lifted up his broken hands and he called upon the Name

[Pre-Chorus]
I took it all
I waited for the fall

[Chorus]
Blessed be the Name
I took it all, he stayed the same
The Lord gave, the Lord took away
Blessed be the Name, and I'm put to shame

[Bridge]
(Numbers-station voice) Subject response intercepted...
(Pitched-down spoken voice) I know that my Redeemer lives
(Growled, slower) Out of the ash, out of the night
I heard him sing, and I lost the fight

[Final Chorus]
(Full intensity, choir stab)
Blessed be the Name
I took it all, he stayed the same
The Lord gave, the Lord took away
Blessed be the Name, and I'm put to shame

[Outro]
(Numbers-station voice) Restoration... double... file closed
(Distorted whisper) Blessed be the Name
